{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Bridge}}
{{Quote|This is not a cattle market on Shaum Hii, Lieutenant Tschel. This is the bridge of an Imperial Star Destroyer.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tschel]]|<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
[[File:StarDestroyerBridge_AoRCR.png|thumb|right|250px|The command bridge of an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer.]]
The '''bridge''', otherwise known as the '''command deck''', was a structure, either attached to the main hull via a tower or pylon, or built into the hull, of nearly all large [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Larger and containing more stations and functionality than a small ship or [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], it was the central hub of a vessel's activity, serving as its primary command-and-control station. 

The typical crew found on a bridge would include senior officers, such as the Captain, the [[executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], the [[weapons-control officer]] and their subordinates, and a [[communications technician]]. In some cases, recorders on the bridge captured the movements and behaviors of the officers.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> From here, the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] could assign courses for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps to be input by the [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogator]], sublight maneuvers to be carried out by the ship's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or, in the case of [[Warship/Legends|warships]], attack strategies and gunnery missions to be executed by the ship's [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]].

The layout of a warship's bridge varied depending on the role of the vessel. For example, [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] designed several warship command bridges with a single, wedge-shaped tower. Some [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] had a distinctive dual-bridge design, such as the [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Secutor'']] or [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator'']] classes.<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Bridges were typically equipped with [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]]. The ''[[Saak'ak]]'' utilized its bridge's blast doors to keep out [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during [[Mission to Naboo|unsuccessful negotiations]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref>

The crash of the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] at the Battle of Endor demonstrated the weakness of typical external bridge design. A single [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighter]] crashed into the bridge during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], breaching its hull and killing the command staff, including [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gherant/Legends|Gherant]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
